card.title: How To Fix an iPad Air 3 With No Backlight

source.title: How To Fix an iPad Air 3 With No Backlight

claims.statement: iPad Air 3 losing backlight after a screen job is usually caused by connecting the screen with the battery still attached, blowing backlight diodes.
A good diode reads OL one way and a value the other; continuity both ways means it is bad. Most iPad backlight diodes are interchangeable from donor boards.
If still dark after replacing diodes, replace all three backlight filters beside the connector even if they measure good.

procedure: Test with known-good and original screens.
Inspect for cracked/blown backlight diodes and diode-test them.
Replace the three backlight filters next to the connector.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Always disconnect the battery before plugging in a screen.
card.caveats: Filter locations are shown in an image on the source page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
